**Fæces calprotectin måling** (fecal calprotectin measurement) is a biological marker for intestinal inflammation that serves as a critical clinical tool in the management of Inflammatory Bowel Disease (IBD) [^src1]. Within the Danish national quality monitoring framework for IBD, known as DANIBD, the application of this biomarker is formally tracked as "Indicator 5," specifically in connection with BMSL [^src1]. 

The measurement and its associated clinical indicator were evaluated in DANIBD's second annual report for 2024, which covers the reporting period from October 1, 2023, to September 30, 2024 [^src1]. This publication marked the first time the registry presented results for all seven of its clinical indicators [^src1]. The systematic evaluation of this biomarker's use is part of a broader assessment of treatment quality—spanning diagnostics, patient education, medical and surgical interventions, and follow-up care—based on comprehensive registry data from 751 children and young people, as well as 33,599 adults with IBD in Denmark [^src1]. Because the available corpus data for this specific entity is limited to a single mention within the report's indicator list, further specific details regarding its clinical thresholds or exact BMSL outcomes are not available in this text.
